Definition: from G4998; to be of sound mind, i.e. sane, (figuratively) moderate:--be in right mind, be sober (minded), soberly.
BiblicalUsage: The word is being in your right mind. The people find the man who had the legion sitting, and clothed, and in his right mind, and they were afraid; Paul tells every man not to think of himself more highly than he ought to think, but to think soberly; and young men are exhorted to be sober minded.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a sound mind is the gift Christ gives and the discipline believers keep, and it shows in how highly we think of ourselves.
